info.title: División Palermo
info.synopsis: I membri di un eterogeneo gruppo di vigilantes formato per migliorare l'immagine della polizia vengono messi in pericolo quando si imbattono in un inaspettato affare di droga.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Felipe joins a civilian Urban Guard made up of people from various minority groups. At first it seems like the easiest job ever. But crime never rests.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: A sensationalist journalist tries to uncover the truth behind the squad. After an incident involving work partner Diego, Felipe plans to leave the group.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: After the media backlash, the Urban Guard patrols a sustainability fair, where Felipe and Sofía catch a criminal. A dangerous person follows Feli.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: A quirky new member joins the team. The romantic tension between Felipe and Sofía keeps growing. Feli discovers a clue to finding out who attacked Diego.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Jonny undertakes a dangerous mission to continue the investigation of Diego's case. Things between Felipe and Sofía get complicated and confusing.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Felipe and Sofía are paired with police officers, forming odd couples to patrol the streets. The investigation of Diego's case takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: The group patrols a rave, which promises to get wild, in a last attempt to keep the division alive. Felipe's parents worry about his recent behavior.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Felipe è in reale pericolo dopo aver collegato tutti i punti del caso, ma il gruppo non lo lascerà solo... anche se questo significa mettere a rischio le loro stesse vite!

translations.value: Felipe è in reale pericolo dopo aver collegato tutti i punti del caso, ma il gruppo non lo lascerà solo... anche se questo significa mettere a rischio le loro stesse vite!

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: As the Guard expands, the Korean mafia wants their money. Intelligence eyes Felipe — his blank face is perfect for the job.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Thanks to the Guard, Palermo is poop-free, but not scam-free. Felipe infiltrates a café and can't avoid trouble.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Botty replaces Betty, bringing the Guard into the 21st century. Felipe explores the dark side, and Sofía finds new ways to let off steam.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: While the Division attempts to give a talk at a school, a group of outcasts pulls off the perfect bank heist. Spoiler: nothing goes as they expected.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Felipe faces a final mission he can't escape. A heat wave, tasers and controversial ice cream spark chaos in Palermo.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Felipe is exposed and his team rescues him again. No one knows what's happening, but something's brewing in Cuero — and it's not coffee.

translations.title: Community Squad
translations.overview: The members of a diverse vigilante group formed to boost the police's image are put in jeopardy when they stumble upon an unexpected drug deal.
Una Guardia Urbana inclusiva, ideada como operación de marketing para mejorar la imagen de las fuerzas de seguridad, descubrirá algo que no debía y se enfrentará con unos extraños narcos.
